title: Capture OAuth client_id from app.wiz.io login
instruction: Open https://app.wiz.io/login in Chrome. Open DevTools → Network → filter by 'authorize'. Click 'Sign in with SSO' button (NOT the email form). Watch for redirect to https://auth.wiz.io/authorize?client_id=XXXXXXXX. Copy the client_id value.
unlocks: OAuth redirect_uri chain → Critical account takeover if win-test.wiz.io accepted

title: Get Looker trial API credentials → test SSRF via SAML endpoint
instruction: 1. Go to cloud.google.com/looker and request a free trial. 2. Or open trial.looker.com in browser and complete any SSO/signup flow. 3. Once logged in: Admin → Users → Edit your user → API3 Keys → New API3 Key. 4. Run: LOOKER_HOST=trial.looker.com LOOKER_CLIENT_ID=<id> LOOKER_CLIENT_SECRET=<secret> bash scripts/looker-ssrf-auth-attack.sh
expected_output: SSRF confirmed → AWS IMDS credentials via /fetch_and_parse_saml_idp_metadata

title: Browser: find digitaltrust.wiz.io SSO provider + test ?tid= IDOR
instruction: 1. Open https://digitaltrust.wiz.io in Chrome (Network tab open). 2. Note the SSO redirect URL. If self-registration available: register. 3. After login, note your ?tid= value in the URL. 4. Substitute another org's tenant ID in API calls to api.digitaltrust.wiz.io. 5. If you see another org's data: Critical cross-tenant IDOR.
expected_output: Another tenant's packages/findings accessible via ?tid= substitution
unlocks: Cross-tenant IDOR → Critical CVSS 9.1 on Wiz TIER1
